warnings.event: Flood Warning: Barbourne Brook at Barbourne
warnings.headline: Flooding is expected: Barbourne Brook at Barbourne
warnings.description:
Rising river levels are expected to cause flooding today. 

Flooding is expected on Tuesday 17 November . 

Flooding may affect properties and roads within the Beechwood Park Estate and the Shelly Close area of Barbourne. 

We are closely monitoring the situation . 

Start acting on your flood plan if you have one.   

This message will be updated by 10:00AM on Wednesday 18 November or as the situation changes.

warnings.event: Flood Warning: Wood Brook and River Soar at Loughborough to the north of Derby Road
warnings.headline: Flooding is expected: Wood Brook and River Soar at Loughborough to the north of Derby Road
warnings.description:
High river levels are expected to cause flooding this morning. 

Flooding is expected from the morning of Tuesday 17 November . 

Areas most at risk are properties at Prince William Way, Prince William Road, Jubilee Drive, Monarch Way, Waldron Court, Belton Road West Extension, Lisle Street and Derby Road near Burleigh Brook. If levels continue to rise, properties at Bottleacre Lane, Belton Road near Bottleacre Lane, Staveley Court, Meadow Avenue, Waterside Close and surrounding areas are at risk. Light rainfall is forecast over the next 6 hours. River levels at Lisle Street Gauge are rising rapidly due to the nature of the catchment. 

We are closely monitoring the situation . 

Move family, pets and cars to safety and turn off gas, electricity and water if it is safe to do so. & start acting on your flood plan, if you have one. 

This message will be updated by 5:00PM on Tuesday 17 November or as the situation changes.

warnings.event: Flood Warning: North Sea at Scarborough - Sandside
warnings.headline: Flooding is expected: North Sea at Scarborough - Sandside
warnings.description:
High tides, strong winds and large waves are expected to cause flooding today. 

Flooding is expected from 11:30 to 21:30 on Tuesday 17th November. 

Locations most affected will be Properties on Sandside around the Old Harbour.
The risk of flooding should reduce once the tide has passed. 

We are closely monitoring the situation . 

Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.   

This message will be updated by 5:00PM on Tuesday 17 November or as the situation changes.
